Mercury · San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States · FP&A / Finance

About the role

Role Overview: We're looking for a hands-on Treasury Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day execution of Mercury's cash management and reporting processes. This is an execution- and build-focused role: you'll manage cash movements and approvals, maintain Treasury's core reporting cadence, and — critically — design and build the automated tools and workflows that let Treasury operate without relying on manual spreadsheet work or costly third-party platforms. We're especially interested in candidates who are fluent with modern AI and prioritize process and reporting automations. If you've automated processes to gain scale and efficiency we want to hear about it.
